evidence_quote: A 13-year-old girl was admitted to the Immunology, Asthma and Allergy Research Institute, Tehran University of Medical Sciences, because of a draining plaque on the left leg for 2.5 years
note: Diagnosed by CD18 flow cytometry; no variant reported.

evidence_quote: LAD-1 was genetically confirmed in the patient in 2008 by one of us (DR) who found 2 heterozygous mutations in the ITGB2 gene
note: Compound heterozygous; parents are carriers only.

evidence_quote: We describe eight patients (identified as P1, P2, P3, P4, P5, P6, P7, P8) with diagnosis of LAD-1 identified from 1993 to 2015
CD18 positivity on neutrophils was markedly reduced (1.48 vs 99.97% in control) and confirmed diagnosis of LAD.
note: Single infant diagnosed by CD18 expression; no variant.

evidence_quote: Microarray analysis and Sanger sequencing revealed a missense mutation (ITGB2: c.817G>A; pGly273Arg) on the paternal allele
note: Single patient with missense plus 1 Mb deletion.

evidence_quote: Fifteen patients were diagnosed with LAD-I after referral to three Turkish clinical centers
One patient with 0% of CD18 (LAD-1) and one patient with 0% of CD15 (LAD-2) were detected.
note: Main text is Spanish with an English abstract; reports one LAD-1 patient by CD18 expression.

evidence_quote: Four patients (5.4%) underwent second HSCTs for disease relapse (HLH n = 2, ALPS n = 1, LAD n = 1).
note: HSCT conditioning cohort of 73 IEI patients; LAD only in aggregate.
